verdict.summary: The retention-aware offset resolution is coherent and complete for the documented restart-after-retention scope. TRIM_HORIZON now starts at ChangeLog::first_seq(), anchored iterators reject only when their resolved start precedes that horizon, and LATEST remains tied to next_seq. The HTTP mapping to 410 is fail-closed and does not expose raw caller input. The end-to-end test performs a real segment trim, reopens the server on the trimmed log, verifies retained replay, verifies a below-horizon anchor returns 410 without records, checks the exact boundary, and confirms LATEST behavior; the focused unit tests cover the same resolution rules and overflow saturation. Documentation accurately discloses the cached-horizon limitation for out-of-band retention while the server is running.
